title: OZZI_DA_BEAST- Important Appeal

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Flyhacking isn't exactly a relative to a "lag spike" or "glitchy teleportation". This is the third time you've been banned for hacking, and as well as on the first appeal, you've admitted to using a hacked client previously on the server.

Posting your channel does not provide sufficient proof that you aren't using cheats, and furthermore, you must wait at least a period of 6 months before having a hacking punishment appealed.
